description: An interior view of the Abiquiu studio with O’Keeffe sitting in profile, hair pulled back in a bun, wearing a black suit looking in the direction of Juan Hamilton who sits back in a chair with his hands over his head. Behind O’Keeffe’s head is one of her paintings of the Black Place, and in the lower right-hand corner of the photograph Lucille Webb's shoes and ankles are visible along with the hind end of one O’Keeffe’s chows.
title: O'Keeffe sitting with Juan Hamilton and Lucille Webb in Abiquiu
